data.one_liner: A simple customizable switch widget with sliding animation and selection state support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a sliding switch widget that can be fully customized with desired width, height, colors, text, and icons. It maintains its own selection state and handles tap, double tap, and swipe interactions.
use_when: You need a custom animated sliding switch instead of the standard platform switches.
You want to support text or icon toggles within a single switch component.
avoid_when: You need a standard platform-native switch widget.
You require a complex form field wrapper out of the box.
strengths: Fully customizable width, colors, text, and icons.
Supports tap, double tap, and swipe events.
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific sliding switch widget design.
Not documented for integration with standard Form validation without extra wrapping.
